notes: Colophon names no person (no scribe, commissioner, king, or author). Date only: "samvat 377" taken as NS (Newari script, three-digit year), consistent with the catalogue's "(N)S 377"; NS 377 ≈ 1256/57 CE; Kārttika kṛṣṇa 4 would fall in late 1256 CE. "caturthasyāṃ" is a corrupt form of caturthyāṃ (marked (!) by cataloguer); "maṅgalavāśare" = maṅgalavāsare (Tuesday). The text title Cāndravyākaraṇa does not appear in the quoted colophon; the author Candragomin is not named.
